description: Defines an interface TimeoutConfig for configuring timeout durations with methods to retrieve minimum and maximum timeout values, including an enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: TimeoutConfig
classes.description: An interface specifying methods for obtaining timeout durations and an enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: TimeoutConfig.TimeoutConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration implementing KnownConfigValue, representing configuration keys and their default timeout values.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for the configuration key.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path string associated with the value.
